landing.when: The Merge Captain queued this branch to land: its work is finished and committed. Land It tells the captain to land it.
landing.why: Saves writing the go-ahead to the captain by hand.
landing.title: Land {branch} at {commit}?

all.label: Land All
all.about: Tells the Merge Captain to land every branch on this card that needs no Merge Without Specs….
all.confirm: Land these branches? {rows}. The captain checks each, then lands, pushes and restarts.

buttons.label: Land It
buttons.about: Tells the Merge Captain to land this branch.

buttons.label: Merge Without Specs…
buttons.about: Lands this commit now; its spec drafts stay behind for a fresh branch.
buttons.send: Go ahead: land {branch} at {commit} without its specs ({drafts}).
buttons.confirm: Land {branch} without its specs? These spec drafts stay behind, to promote later on a fresh branch from {base}: {drafts}.

buttons.label: Not Yet
buttons.about: Tells this session's agent to keep working; the captain waits for a new commit.
buttons.send: Not yet: keep working on this branch.
